articles.title: US approves sale of 48 F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: 📰 싱가포르 최신 뉴스\n📢 US approves sale of 48 F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia...
articles.content: It "will also augment Saudi Arabia's operational aircraft and enhance its air-to-air, and air-to-ground self-defense capability," the statement said. The State Department has notified Congress about the proposed sale, which would require the approval of US lawmakers
